verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a Management API to manage projects programmatically, and a CLI that starts a full local Supabase stack in two commands, plus docs on connecting to the resulting Postgres database. Nothing shows hosted database creation happening in seconds or that no capacity planning is needed, and the region docs imply some upfront choices. Missing for 10: evidence of hosted database provisioning time in seconds, explicit no-capacity-planning or serverless sizing, a documented CLI or API create-project flow returning a ready connection string, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a ready-to-connect database in seconds through the CLI or API without capacity planning

citations.quote: Manage your Supabase organizations and projects programmatically.
With two commands, you can set up and start a new local project: 1. supabase init to create a new local project, 2. supabase start to launch the Supabase services
Supabase provides several ways to connect to your Postgres database, whether your code runs in the frontend, in a persistent backend, or in a serverless function.
